summary: Keep structured internal native content out of transcript prose instead of rendering its legacy text fallback.

schema.detail: Uses existing timeline block visibility; no wire or storage changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The web client preserves internal and hidden-by-harness presentation blocks as UnknownEvents, hidden by the existing transcript policy. Source-record annotations do not hide independent visible prose. Visible JSON messages and legacy entries without blocks retain their existing presentation.
